# Method SetViewScaleFactor

#### SetViewScaleFactor(ElementId, double)

##### Declaration

```
[AvailableSinceVersion(7, 20, 255, 0)]
void SetViewScaleFactor(ElementId inElementId, double inScaleFactorAbsoluteValue)
```

##### Parameters

|  Type |  Name |  Description |
